item.text: I’ll build a self-contained SDF scene with a connected bicycle, a posed pelican rider, and orbit controls for close inspection.

The scene design includes a long beak and pouch, feathered wings reaching the handlebars, and feet that follow the pedals. I’m adding cursor-centered zoom and panning so each contact point can be inspected closely.
The pedal motion is worked out with fixed-length legs, so both feet stay on the pedals throughout the cycle. I’m finishing the lighting, materials, and WebGL context-loss handling.

The camera controls, deterministic frame inputs, cleanup, and context restoration pass the available logic checks. The module is under 30 KB; I couldn’t run a browser rendering check in this environment.
